# Third-party notices

hxn-assets depends on HaxeFoundation format 3.8.0 under its BSD license.
The original terms are retained in [LICENSE](licenses/format-3.8.0/LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/HaxeFoundation/format (haxelib version 3.8.0).

PNG decoding runs at compilation for embedded images. Applications selecting
runtime PNG decoding also include that decoder; preserve its terms with binaries.
Native file-storage dependency notices are distributed by hxn-file.

The embedded KyuGraph engine and both build variants retain their pinned native
[notices, license texts and source archives](native/NOTICES.md). These ship with
hxn-assets. The independent hxn-file inventory covers platform I/O.
